WITH RECURSIVE seconds(sec) AS (
  SELECT 100 UNION ALL SELECT sec + 1 FROM seconds WHERE sec < 159
), occupancy AS (
  SELECT w.queue_code, s.sec, COUNT(DISTINCT w.wait_key) AS peak_calls
  FROM seconds AS s
  JOIN call_waits AS w ON w.enter_sec <= s.sec AND (w.leave_sec IS NULL OR s.sec < w.leave_sec)
  GROUP BY w.queue_code, s.sec
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY queue_code ORDER BY peak_calls DESC, sec ASC) AS position
  FROM occupancy
)
SELECT queue_code, peak_calls, sec AS first_peak_sec
FROM ranked WHERE position = 1
ORDER BY queue_code ASC
